title: SpaceX stock's two-day run, explained
subtitle: An 8% jump, two bullish analyst notes, and what the options market is pricing.
as_of: Grounded in Jim's Interest Journal research for Oct 5 and Oct 6, 2026. Prices are approximate as reported; not investment advice.

scenes.label: Monday, Oct 5
scenes.heading: Highest close since *mid-June*

data.label: Highest close since mid-June, after the IPO

scenes.caption: SpaceX stock jumped about 8% on Monday to close at $171.09, the highest since mid-June after the IPO. Forbes has Musk back at about $1.03 trillion.
scenes.narration: SpaceX stock jumped about 8% on Monday to close at $171.09, the highest since mid-June after the IPO. Forbes has Musk back at about 1.03 trillion dollars.
evidence: SpaceX stock up ~8%; Musk is a trillionaire again.
Shares closed at $171.09, the highest since mid-June after the IPO.

scenes.label: Tuesday, Oct 6
scenes.heading: A smaller gain, after a higher high
scenes.caption: On Tuesday it rose another 0.5% to about $171.92, after touching about $176.42 intraday.
evidence: SpaceX stock +0.5% to about $171.92, after Monday's ~8% jump.
It hit about $176.42 intraday and traded around $173.66 at midday.

scenes.label: Wall Street
scenes.heading: Price targets vs. where it trades
scenes.caption: Morgan Stanley called the stock cheap, with a Buy rating and a $300 target. On Tuesday, Goldman raised its target to $230 from $220, citing higher forecasts for the AI business.
evidence: called the stock "cheap" with a Buy rating and a $300 target
Goldman's Eric Sheridan raised his target to $230 from $220 and kept Buy, citing higher forecasts for the AI business

scenes.label: The options market
scenes.heading: Calmer than the debut

cards.label: Monday's options volume vs. the 30-day average
implied volatility, vs. over 110 at the June debut
priced chance of touching $185 by end of October

scenes.caption: CNBC noted Monday's options volume was twice the 30-day average. Implied volatility is about 55, versus over 110 at the June debut. Options gave about a 54% chance of touching $185 by the end of October.
evidence: CNBC noted that options volume Monday was twice the 30-day average.
Implied volatility is about 55, versus over 110 at the June debut.
Options pricing gave about a 54% chance of touching $185 by the end of October.

scenes.label: What could move it next
scenes.heading: Two things to watch

lines: Morgan Stanley: a Starship *ship catch* could be *"the biggest positive catalyst since the IPO."*
CNBC: *Q3 earnings* expected in late October.

scenes.caption: Morgan Stanley says a Starship ship catch on the next flight could be the biggest positive catalyst since the IPO. And CNBC says Q3 earnings are expected in late October.
evidence: a Starship ship catch on the next flight could be "the biggest positive catalyst since the IPO."
CNBC also says Q3 earnings are expected in late October.
